notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Tok Pisin i laikim objekt 'em', hebrai i no gat em long ples bilong 'usim'

notes.subject: ol ken usim long olgeta kain wok
notes.rationale: Sam man i tanim 'ye'ases lekol melakha' olsem 'ol ken usim long eni wok' (KJV, JPS), sam olsem 'ol i wokim long eni samting' (YLT); min i stap liklik hat

translation: Na gris bilong animal i dai long en yet, na gris bilong animal ol wail animal i kapsaitim — ol ken usim ⟨em⟩ long olgeta kain wok; tasol long kaikai, yu ol i no ken kaikai ⟨em⟩.
